items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: I wanted to ask you about your father's teacher. You named that color Charles C.R.?

ctx.x: John Porter was a good baritone, good tuba player. He was good all around. He played baritone, left him out for baritone. Very good musician. He knew he was going to know what happened. Well, he come from, you know, from a play of mystery. You know, you had to be a good reader. You had to know what you were doing. Like the guys today, they pick up a tube. I mean, they can't read the parts. I mean, you don't know. I mean, it seemed like they got a bad hearing or something. I don't know. I don't know what happens…
I wanted to ask you about your father's teacher. You named that color Charles C.R.?
